   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Tuning a multicell cavity: mid and end cells\n",
    "\n",
    "In a multicell cavity the accelerating mode is the **&pi;-mode** — the highest\n",
    "frequency of the fundamental passband, where the field flips sign from cell to\n",
    "cell. Two jobs have to be done to place it on target with a **flat field**:\n",
    "\n",
    "- The **interior (mid) cells** set the passband. Tuning the shared equator radius\n",
    "  `Req` of the mid cells moves the whole passband, and with it the &pi;-mode.\n",
    "- The **end cells** are perturbed by the beam pipes, which pull their frequency\n",
    "  away from the interior. Left uncorrected the end cells are under-excited and the\n",
    "  field is not flat. They are tuned **independently** — here through the end-cell\n",
    "  half-length `L` — to restore flatness and pin the &pi;-mode exactly.\n",
    "\n",
    "We build a 9-cell TESLA-like cavity with beam pipes and tune it in two stages.\n",
    "See the [tuning guide](../../tuning)."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "47640882",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-07-26T23:12:29.154209Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-07-26T23:12:29.153951Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-07-26T23:12:45.321369Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-07-26T23:12:45.320513Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import os\n",
    "import tempfile\n",
    "\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "from cavsim2d import EllipticalCavity\n",
    "from cavsim2d.utils.style import apply_style, WARM\n",
    "\n",
    "apply_style()\n",
    "\n",
    "EIG = {'polarisation': 'monopole', 'n_modes': 12,\n",
    "       'boundary_conditions': 'mm', 'mesh_config': {'h': 6, 'p': 2}}\n",
    "\n",
    "def pi_mode(cav):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Solve and return (pi-mode frequency [MHz], field flatness [%]).\"\"\"\n",
    "    cav.eigenmode.run(EIG)\n",
    "    q = cav.eigenmode.qois\n",
    "    return q['freq [MHz]'], q['ff [%]']\n",
    "\n",
    "def axis_field(cav):\n",
    "    \"\"\"On-axis |Ez| profile of the last-solved mode, peak-normalised.\"\"\"\n",
    "    df = pd.read_csv(cav.eigenmode.pol_folder(0) / 'Ez_0_abs.csv', sep='\\t')\n",
    "    z = df['z(0, 0)'].to_numpy()\n",
    "    ez = df['|Ez(0, 0)|'].to_numpy()\n",
    "    return z, ez / ez.max()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "287df7f3",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 1. A detuned 9-cell cavity\n",
    "\n",
    "All cells start identical with an oversized equator radius, and a beam pipe on\n",
    "each end. `beampipe='both'` is what makes the end cells differ from the interior."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "196c479f",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-07-26T23:12:45.324977Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-07-26T23:12:45.324567Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-07-26T23:12:45.822652Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-07-26T23:12:45.821593Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 800x300 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "TESLA = [42, 42, 12, 19, 35, 57.7, 108.0]   # [A, B, a, b, Ri, L, Req], mm\n",
    "\n",
    "def fresh(name):\n",
    "    cav = EllipticalCavity(9, TESLA, list(TESLA), list(TESLA),\n",
    "                           beampipe='both', name=name)\n",
    "    cav.set_workspace(os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), name))\n",
    "    return cav\n",
    "\n",
    "ax = fresh('view').plot('geometry', show=False)\n",
    "ax.set_title('9-cell cavity, detuned (Req = 108 mm)')\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "4ddc49f3",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 2. Stage one — tune the mid cells\n",
    "\n",
    "Tuning only the mid-cell `Req` drops the &pi;-mode close to the target, but the\n",
    "beam-pipe-loaded end cells are left untuned, so the field is far from flat."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "f61e759c",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-07-26T23:12:45.825172Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-07-26T23:12:45.824885Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-07-26T23:13:28.467517Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-07-26T23:13:28.465965Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "mid cells only:  pi-mode = 1299.426 MHz,  field flatness = 30.0 %\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "cav_mid = fresh('mid_only')\n",
    "cav_mid.tune.run({'freqs': 1300.0,\n",
    "                  'cell_type': {'mid-cell': 'Req'},\n",
    "                  'eigenmode_config': {'boundary_conditions': 'mm',\n",
    "                                       'mesh_config': {'h': 6, 'p': 2}}})\n",
    "f_mid, ff_mid = pi_mode(cav_mid.tuned)\n",
    "print(f\"mid cells only:  pi-mode = {f_mid:.3f} MHz,  field flatness = {ff_mid:.1f} %\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "a69ab729",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The on-axis field shows the two end cells sagging below the interior — the\n",
    "signature of untuned, beam-pipe-loaded ends."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "f56ea3eb",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-07-26T23:13:28.470614Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-07-26T23:13:28.470303Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-07-26T23:13:28.611075Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-07-26T23:13:28.610215Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 700x300 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "z, ez = axis_field(cav_mid.tuned)\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3))\n",
    "ax.plot(z * 1e3, ez, color=WARM[0])\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel('z [mm]'); ax.set_ylabel('|Ez| (normalised)')\n",
    "ax.set_title(f'mid cells only — field flatness {ff_mid:.0f}%')\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "2e7edba3",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 3. Stage two — add the end cells\n",
    "\n",
    "Now schedule **two** cell types in one call: the mid cells keep tuning `Req`, and\n",
    "the end cells tune their half-length `L` independently. Because the stages run in\n",
    "order, the end-cell tune sees the already-tuned interior and lengthens the end\n",
    "cells just enough to compensate the beam-pipe loading."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "1b4c006b",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-07-26T23:13:28.614094Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-07-26T23:13:28.613806Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-07-26T23:14:26.645347Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-07-26T23:14:26.644353Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "mid + end cells: pi-mode = 1300.040 MHz,  field flatness = 98.3 %\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "cav = fresh('mid_and_end')\n",
    "cav.tune.run({'freqs': 1300.0,\n",
    "              'cell_type': {'mid-cell': 'Req', 'end-cell': 'L'},\n",
    "              'eigenmode_config': {'boundary_conditions': 'mm',\n",
    "                                   'mesh_config': {'h': 6, 'p': 2}}})\n",
    "f_full, ff_full = pi_mode(cav.tuned)\n",
    "print(f\"mid + end cells: pi-mode = {f_full:.3f} MHz,  field flatness = {ff_full:.1f} %\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "7af2327b",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The field is now flat across all nine cells, and the &pi;-mode sits on 1300 MHz."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "36d865d0",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-07-26T23:14:26.647380Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-07-26T23:14:26.647120Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-07-26T23:14:26.882166Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-07-26T23:14:26.881243Z"
    }
   },

      "image/png": "",

      ]
     },

     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "z2, ez2 = axis_field(cav.tuned)\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3))\n",
    "ax.plot(z * 1e3, ez, color=WARM[0], alpha=0.5, label=f'mid only ({ff_mid:.0f}%)')\n",
    "ax.plot(z2 * 1e3, ez2, color=WARM[2], label=f'mid + end ({ff_full:.0f}%)')\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel('z [mm]'); ax.set_ylabel('|Ez| (normalised)')\n",

   ]

   "source": [
    "## 4. The independently tuned cells\n",
    "\n",
    "`cav.tune.qois` reports each cell type separately: the mid cells converged on an\n",
    "equator radius, the end cells on a half-length. Both live on the single tuned\n",
    "cavity, whose &pi;-mode is the target frequency."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "9ccbcdff",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-07-26T23:14:26.885540Z",

   },

      "end cells:  L   = 61.072 mm   (tuned ['L_el'])\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "mid = cav.tune.qois['mid-cell']\n",
    "end = cav.tune.qois['end-cell']\n",
    "print(f\"mid cells:  Req = {mid['parameters']['Req_m']:.3f} mm   (tuned {mid['TUNED VARIABLES']})\")\n",
    "print(f\"end cells:  L   = {end['parameters']['L_el']:.3f} mm   (tuned {end['TUNED VARIABLES']})\")"
   ]
